text: The goal is a hundred thousand dollars.
The land and somewhere to work are already mine, so the campaign can focus on the next practical steps.
One to three pads as a test group, and one to three dome designs built and measured.
Develop the pad architecture so the next site starts with a plan and a cut list, instead of another invention.

Most of the work is modular design and the means to do it: woodworking and metalworking, CNC plasma, three-D printers, a router or mill, casting materials, and the tools to panelize the frame I already have.
Then the web app, hosting, documentation, a camera, and real promotion.
I want this idea to spread like the flu, instead of sitting in a repository.
This is a small pilot, not a claim that all the engineering is finished.
The rotating tracking foundation stays outside this first campaign's funded scope.
I intend to develop it later.
